title: Two-layer forward pass, by hand
statement_md:
Write `forward(x, W1, b1, W2, b2)` for one example through `n_in -> n_hidden -> 1`.

1. `z1 = W1 x + b1` (each row of `W1` is one hidden unit)
2. `a1 = ReLU(z1)`
3. `z2 = W2 a1 + b2`
4. return `sigmoid(z2)` as a `float`

Raise `ValueError` if the shapes do not line up (`W1` is `n_hidden x n_in`, `W2` is `1 x n_hidden`).
